- [USER] User inquired about the best tech stack for web app development using Python.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The best tech stack for web app development using Python includes the following:
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flask or Django as the web framework.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] PostgreSQL or MySQL as the database.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bootstrap or Materialize for front-end design and responsiveness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flask-Restplus or Django Rest Framework for building RESTful APIs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flask-SocketIO or Django Channels for real-time communication and websockets.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flask-Security or Django-Guardian for authentication and authorization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flask-Testing or Django-Testing for unit testing and integration testing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Flask-Sqlalchemy or Django-ORM for object-relational mapping.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Gunicorn or uWSGI for deployment and scaling of the web application.
